meta.title: Code Blue
meta.notes: Celeste POV S01-S10 test loop build.
meta.blurb: Authority is earned in silence and blood. As Dr. Celeste Marlowe, you command the ER. But control is fragile when power, attraction, and ambition collide.

S01.text:
The ER hums under fluorescent light.

You step onto the floor and the energy shifts. Nurses straighten. Residents quiet. Authority does not announce itself. It is felt.

A new intern stands near the trauma board, trying to look composed.

You recognize that look.

Ambition mixed with fear.

You decide what kind of night this will be.

----------------
CHOICES
TAKE CONTROL
Test him immediately and establish dominance.

OBSERVE FIRST
Watch how he moves before you intervene.

ALIGN WITH STAFF
Stabilize the room before testing anyone.

KEEP DISTANCE
Remain detached and clinical.

S02.text:
You hand him a chart without slowing your stride.

"Keep up," you say.

He does.

Under pressure, people reveal themselves.

He hesitates once, corrects, and recovers.

Interesting.

----------------
CHOICES
PUSH HARDER
Increase pressure.

OFFER GUIDANCE
Refine instead of crush.

PUBLIC TEST
Challenge him in front of staff.

STEP BACK
Let him breathe.

S03.text:
You watch.

Observation is leverage.

He checks vitals twice. Good instinct.

The floor is tense tonight.

You sense something coming.

----------------
CHOICES
INTERVENE LATE
Step in only when necessary.

LET HIM STRUGGLE
Growth requires discomfort.

CALL OUT ERROR
Assert authority.

FOCUS ON PATIENT
Shift attention away.

S04.text:
You recalibrate the room.

Orders tighten. Noise narrows.

Power is not loud.

It is efficient.

A monitor spikes.

There it is.

----------------
CHOICES
RUN THE CODE
Take command yourself.

DELEGATE
Test someone else.

SHARE CONTROL
Split authority carefully.

OBSERVE
Read the room first.

S05.text:
You remain detached.

Professional.

Controlled.

The intern notices.

Distance can be power.

But it can also be invitation.

----------------
CHOICES
SOFTEN
Lower your guard slightly.

HARDEN
Double down on distance.

SHIFT FOCUS
Turn attention elsewhere.

END SHIFT
Walk away.

S06.text:
The patient crashes.

You command the room with surgical precision.

Hands move. Orders land clean.

The intern keeps up.

After stabilization, he looks at you differently.

Not intimidated.

Interested.

----------------
CHOICES
KEEP PROFESSIONAL
Shut it down.

ALLOW TENSION
Let subtext linger.

MENTOR HIM
Guide him deliberately.

CREATE DISTANCE
End it before it starts.

S07.text:
You step closer.

Authority shifts into intimacy.

He holds your gaze.

Power is a delicate thing.

Cross it, and it changes everything.

----------------
CHOICES
PULL BACK
Reassert control.

LEAN IN
Let chemistry grow.

INTERRUPT
Break the moment.

CALL IT DONE
End the shift.

S08.text:
You choose professionalism.

Reputation matters.

The hospital board is watching.

Every move counts.

You remind yourself who you are.

----------------
CHOICES
RETURN TO FLOOR
Continue the shift.

END NIGHT
Close the chapter.

S09.text:
Tension lingers in the air.

This is dangerous.

Not because of policy.

Because of desire.

You decide how far it goes.

----------------
CHOICES
STOP HERE
Reclaim control.

CONTINUE
Risk everything.

WALK AWAY
Reset completely.

S10.text:
The shift ends.

The ER quiets.

You stand alone under fluorescent light.

Authority restored.

Temptation unresolved.

Tomorrow, it begins again.

----------------
CHOICES
BEGIN AGAIN
Start a new shift.
